bug_semantics: picklescan is a denylist scanner: it extracts pickle GLOBAL/STACK_GLOBAL imports and flags a file as infected only when the (module, name) pair matches _unsafe_globals (originally _suspicious_globals). Unknown globals are treated as non-issues (later SafetyLevel.Suspicious, not counted in issues_count). lib2to3.pgen2.grammar.Grammar.loads is a REDUCE gadget that internally pickle.loads() its bytes argument, so a malicious inner payload (e.g. posix.system) never appears as a top-level GLOBAL. Before 0.0.29 the denylist omitted Grammar.loads, so crafted pickles passed the scan and executed on pickle.load(). CWE-502 incomplete denylist; first-party GHSA-f54q-57x4-jg88, affected <0.0.29.
flaw_origin: The incomplete denylist and 'unlisted GLOBAL is not an issue' lookup were first written in c1d5abdcc740e0d08a0d12d015d08e1e6f29a67e (Implement Pickle scanner), which created src/picklescan/scanner.py with _suspicious_globals (builtins/eval family, webbrowser, httplib, requests, aiohttp, nt, posix) and scan_pickle_bytes lines 84-88 that increment issues_count only on a denylist hit. git log -L on the dict traces continuously from that add through the f98f9bd rename to _unsafe_globals and later additive entries; none of those commits introduced Grammar.loads. Immediate parent 6a76b8c3ac67dc04181e600614ecf2a423cca326 is boilerplate only (no scanner.py). The 0.0.29 fix aecd11be98702caa9ba9b12189d91ad596a36114 added "lib2to3.pgen2.grammar": {"Grammar.loads"}.
